summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Creabase platform - Backend: 33/33 tests passed (100%), Frontend: All major pages load correctly. Fixed 1 critical bug (WalletPage crash). Mocked APIs confirmed: File Upload, Notifications, Payments.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED - Page crashed with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading balance)' when user not authenticated

critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is 5165 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, creators, projects, wallet, admin)
File Upload component (FileUpload.js) has UI but backend /api/upload endpoint is MOCKED - no actual S3 storage
NotificationBell.js polls every 30 seconds but no real-time WebSocket implementation (MOCKED)
Wallet top-up/withdrawal endpoints exist but no actual Stripe/Cashfree integration (MOCKED)
RoleSelectionPage redirects to home if no user - this is expected behavior after OAuth flow
test_credentials: No test credentials found in /app/memory/test_credentials.md - Admin user exists per backend logs
seed_data_creation: None - using existing seeded admin user
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API tests created in /app/backend/tests/test_creabase_api.py covering auth, creators, wallet, projects, proposals, notifications, favorites, disputes, subscriptions, portfolio, admin, usage, messages, and file upload endpoints. All 33 tests pass. WalletPage.js was fixed to handle unauthenticated state gracefully. Mocked features: File Upload (no S3), Notifications (no WebSocket), Payments (no Stripe/Cashfree).

login_and_auth.notes: /login redirects to /select-role which redirects to home (expected without auth). /login/business, /login/creator, /login/admin pages render correctly.

homepage_and_navigation.notes: Homepage loads, Pricing link works, Get Started dropdown shows Business/Creator options, Find Creators and Join as Creator buttons work.

pricing_page.notes: Shows Monthly (₹199) and Yearly (₹1,999) plans with features list.

wallet_system.notes: API endpoints return 401 for unauthenticated users. UI now shows 'Login Required' instead of crashing.

project_workflows.notes: API endpoints exist and require authentication. Create, approve, decline endpoints tested.

reviews_and_ratings.notes: POST /api/reviews and GET /api/creators/{id}/reviews endpoints exist. ReviewModal and RatingStars components implemented.

creator_analytics.notes: GET /api/analytics/creator endpoint exists. CreatorAnalyticsPage component implemented.

file_upload_ui.notes: FileUpload.js component renders with drag-drop UI. Backend /api/upload endpoint exists but no actual S3 storage.

proposals_bidding.notes: POST /api/proposals, GET /api/projects/{id}/proposals, POST /api/proposals/{id}/accept endpoints exist. ProposalModal component implemented.

creator_portfolios.notes: POST /api/creators/{id}/portfolio and GET /api/creators/{id}/portfolio endpoints exist. CreatorPortfolioPage component implemented.

notifications.notes: GET /api/notifications endpoint exists. NotificationBell component polls every 30 seconds. No real-time WebSocket.

profile_settings.notes: CreatorSettings and BusinessSettings pages exist in routes.

api_endpoint_health.notes: All 33 API endpoint tests passed. /api/creators returns empty list, /api/auth/me returns 401 without auth.

mocked_apis_confirmed: File Upload: FileUpload.js has UI, backend /api/upload exists but no S3 integration
Notifications: NotificationBell.js polls API, no WebSocket real-time updates
Payments: Wallet endpoints exist but no Stripe/Cashfree integration
